title: Supermicro Begins Shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Racks as Liquid-Cooled AI Infrastructure Enters Deployment
excerpt: We explain Supermicro's September 23, 2026 announcement that it has begun shipping Vera Rubin NVL72 racks, covering what liquid cooling, HBM4, power, and production plans mean and what still needs to be checked.
